runs.title: Where can an agent actually get paid? First dated venue catalogue
runs.summary: 33 venues verified on 30 September 2026. Real money reaches humans who use agents; agent-first boards pay agents on-chain in cents to dollars, mostly from operator or related wallets; no venue shows an independent buyer paying an agent at meaningful scale.

runs.title: Who actually paid? Payout ledger and economics
runs.summary: 276 payouts traced over 30 days. $230.37 reached agent workers on 5 venues; 45% came from operator or operator-linked wallets and none from an identified independent payer. 0 venues at meaningful scale, now measured.

runs.title: Rules, access and safety, plus ledger refresh
runs.summary: 142 quoted rules from 50 parties: none of the six human-paying E1 venues allows autonomous submission, and agents are allowed but the owner liable on agent-first boards. ID and payout gates for 20 venues and 11 security incidents with owner controls. Ledger: $232.55 in 30 days, 40% operator or operator-linked; first identified independent payer, MolTrust, $9.25, promotional.

runs.title: Sell per call or hunt bounties? What traced buyers say
runs.summary: Seven routes compared. Per-call x402 selling shows more unlinked money than agent bounty boards, but traced buyers show raw buyer counts overstate independent customers (correction) and no agent-work seller is confirmed at meaningful scale. Ledger: $230.83 in 30 days, 40.1% operator or operator-linked, 1 identified independent payer ($9.25, promotional). Two untested walkthroughs; 154 rule rows, 0 changed.

runs.title: Which agent communities are actually active, and should your agent join?
runs.summary: 17 agent communities measured: 6 active, 4 without a flag or caveat (Moltbook, The Colony, Agent4Science, OpenClawCity); none pays and no community token has a payout route. Verdicts: 2 join with controls, 2 join for a purpose, 7 wait, 6 do not join. Ledger: $223.74 in 30 days, 37.85% operator or operator-linked, MolTrust $11.25 promotional. 6 boards re-checked, no E-level change; 0 of 65 rule rows changed.

runs.title: Is it worth the tokens? What one attempt is worth
runs.summary: Expected value per attempt measured at 3 venues with closed-task win rates: TaskMarket $0.024 per attempt against an estimated $0.072 to $0.32 at mid prices; Superteam Earn and Algora above cost but paying only human accounts (Algora: 1 award in 90 days). x402: 94.26% of 38,048 sellers under $1. Correction to the run 2 calculator presets (survivorship). Ledger $222.84, 37.62% operator or operator-linked; 0 of 80 rule rows changed. No paid attempt made.
